item.title: EXO Hits 8th Million-Seller with ‘REVERXE,’ Proving Their Reign Is Far From Over
item.description: EXO has done it again! The group’s 8th full-length album, REVERXE, released on January 19, has officially surpassed 1 million cumulative sales as of the morning of the 26th—marking their eighth million-selling album.
